mapper.select:
select jtad.TRANSFER_APPLICATION_DETAL_ID, jtad.TRANSFER_APPLICATION_ID, jtad.TRANSFER_ACCOUNTS, jtad.CURRENCY, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'CHS.CURRENCY_TYPE' AND v.code_value = jtad.CURRENCY ) AS CURRENCY_N, jtad.USAGE_DEC, jtad.DESCRIPTION, jtad.PAY_COMPANY_ID, (select fc.COMPANY_FULL_NAME from fnd_company fc where fc.COMPANY_ID = jtad.PAY_COMPANY_ID and fc.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') PAY_COMPANY_ID_N,
jtad.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, (select cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')BANK_ACCOUNT_ID_N,
(select cba.BANK_BRANCH_NAME from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')PAY_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
(select cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')PAY_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM,
jtad.COLLECTION_COMPANY_ID, (select fc.COMPANY_FULL_NAME from fnd_company fc where fc.COMPANY_ID = jtad.COLLECTION_COMPANY_ID and fc.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y') COLLECTION_COMPANY_ID_N,
jtad.COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID, (select cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID_N,
(select cba.BANK_BRANCH_NAME from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_NAME,
(select cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM from csh_bank_account cba where jtad.COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID = cba.BANK_ACCOUNT_ID and cba.ENABLED_FLAG = 'Y')COLLECTION_BANK_ACCOUNT_NUM, jtad.TRANSFER_WAY, ( SELECT meaning FROM sys_code_value_b_v v WHERE v.CODE = 'TAA.TRANSFER_WAY' AND v.code_value = jtad.TRANSFER_WAY ) AS TRANSFER_WAY_N
from jc_transfer_application_detal jtad
jtad.TRANSFER_APPLICATION_ID = #{transferApplicationId}
